changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: A Defra ID session survives an organisation switch, but the switch is a new interactive sign-in with a new active relationship. Replace the session-only de-duplication key with session plus active relationship so each organisation context is audited, while retries of the same sign-in remain a no-op. The append-only guard triggers are deliberately unchanged.

changeSet.author: bng-team
changeSet.comment: Deduplicate retries with a known session but no active relationship. NULL session ids remain distinct, including when the relationship is also NULL. Keep the already-applied changeSet 37 unchanged.
